exception_scope: local to #510; does not change standing methodology
precedent: #508 cycle2b method only; no cycle2b golds used as tuning data
anchor_definition: one atomic proposition with contiguous evidence in one H2 section; at most one gold per section
anchor_id: sha256(cookigram-anchor-v1 + POSIX path + normalized heading path + stable proposition_key)

canonicalization.heading_path: Unicode NFC, casefold, collapse Unicode whitespace, strip edge punctuation
canonicalization.proposition_key: stable semantic proposition identifier, assigned before question wording; phrasing and row IDs do not affect identity

split_rule: whole-document allocation fixed before any dev gold is written; no section slot can move across sides
anti_leakage: no holdout gold, question, answer, evidence, label, or proposition key may be read, inspected, generated, or used during dev construction/calibration
a paraphrase or trivial rewording retains its stable proposition_key and canonical anchor identity
duplicate canonical anchor IDs and duplicate proposition keys within a set are rejected
holdout is not materialized in this phase and requires a new Human Owner GO
